title: OpenCode Plugin Brings Claude Code to Official CLI
summary: Developer Khalil Gharbaoui launches OpenCode plugin enabling Claude Code execution inside the official Claude CLI. Available now on GitHub.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Developer Khalil Gharbaoui released an OpenCode plugin that runs Claude Code directly inside Anthropic's official CLI interface.
- The plugin bridges Claude Code's agentic capabilities with the lightweight command-line experience preferred by terminal-first developers.
- Available now on GitHub as an open-source integration, expanding Claude Code's accessibility beyond dedicated desktop applications.


A new open-source plugin enables developers to run[Claude Code](https://emergent.sh/learn/claude-code-review) 's agentic coding capabilities directly inside Anthropic's official command-line interface. Developer Khalil Gharbaoui launched the OpenCode plugin on October 31, 2026, bridging the gap between Claude Code's autonomous development features and the lightweight terminal experience many engineers prefer.


## What the OpenCode Plugin Does


The OpenCode plugin integrates Claude Code functionality into the official Claude CLI, allowing developers to trigger AI-assisted coding workflows without leaving their terminal environment. According to the GitHub repository, the plugin leverages the existing Claude CLI infrastructure while adding Claude Code's ability to read, write, and execute code across project files.


This integration addresses a common developer workflow challenge: accessing Claude Code's powerful agentic capabilities without switching to a separate desktop application or web interface. Terminal-first developers can now maintain their command-line productivity while gaining access to Claude Code's autonomous coding features.


## Release Date and Availability


Officially released on October 31, 2026, the plugin is available now through Gharbaoui's GitHub repository. The project ships as an open-source tool, enabling developers to inspect, modify, and contribute to the integration layer between OpenCode and the Claude CLI.


The plugin requires both the official Claude CLI installation and appropriate API credentials from Anthropic. Setup documentation walks users through the configuration process, including environment variable management and authentication token handling.


## Technical Architecture


The OpenCode plugin operates as a middleware layer between user commands and the Claude API. When developers invoke Claude Code operations through the CLI, the plugin translates terminal instructions into the proper API calls, managing context windows and file system interactions behind the scenes.


Key technical features include:


- Direct file system access for reading and modifying project code
- Session state management across multiple CLI invocations
- Streaming response handling for real-time feedback in the terminal
- Error handling and retry logic for network interruptions


The architecture maintains compatibility with existing Claude CLI commands while extending functionality specifically for code generation and modification workflows.


## Developer Community Response


The Hacker News community discovery of this plugin reflects growing interest in terminal-based AI coding workflows. While the initial Show HN post garnered modest engagement, the plugin addresses a specific need within the developer community: integrating advanced AI capabilities into existing terminal-based development environments.


The open-source nature of the project invites community contributions, potentially accelerating feature development and edge case handling. Developers interested in command-line AI tools now have a reference implementation for building similar integrations.


## What This Means


The OpenCode plugin represents a meaningful step toward making AI-assisted coding more accessible across different development environments. By bringing Claude Code capabilities to the official CLI, Gharbaoui's work demonstrates how community developers can extend enterprise AI tools to match diverse workflow preferences. Terminal-focused engineers gain a new option for incorporating agentic coding into their existing processes, while the broader developer community benefits from an open-source template for similar integrations. This launch underscores the ongoing convergence of AI capabilities with traditional developer tooling, making advanced coding assistance available wherever developers choose to work.
